description: 平成27年(2015年)佐賀県統計年鑑(平成27年版)第27章(労働災害発生状況等) [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 佐賀県. 平成27年(2015年)佐賀県統計年鑑(平成27年版)第２７章（労働災害発生状況等）のデータです。. Coverage: 佐賀県. The portal files it under the publisher 佐賀県. Its tags are 統計. It offers 6 resource(s) in csv, xlsx. The portal shows 2019-10-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
